chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Mahbub from Abdillah ibn Sinan from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

A man from the Ansar came to Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) and said to him, 'I have been tested with a great matter. I had a slave girl whom I used to have intercourse with. One day I had intercourse with her, then I went out for my own need after I had bathed from her, and I forgot a debt/expense owed to me, so I returned to the house to take it, and I found my slave girl lying on her back. I counted for her from that day nine months, and she gave birth to a girl.'

He said, and Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said to him, 'It is not appropriate for you to have intercourse with her, nor to sell her, but spend from your wealth on her as long as you are alive. Then, upon your death, instruct that she be spent from your wealth until Allah, Exalted and Mighty, makes a way out for her.'

key_terms.أَطَأُهَا: I used to have intercourse with her

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a master who impregnates his slave girl through a single act of intercourse?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* illustrates the specific juristic ruling for *Istibra* (waiting period) and lineage establishment when a master impregnates his slave girl through a single act of intercourse after purification. Imam al-Sadiq (AS) prescribes that the master must retain her, providing continuous maintenance from his own wealth during his lifetime and bequeathing funds for her support after death until she is emancipated, thereby ensuring her dignity and financial security independent of sale.
